An installer. Open the unpacked Roadster drawer and double-click **Install_Roadster**: it asks where the Roadster drawer should go (default `SYS:`, so it becomes `SYS:Roadster`), copies Roadster, its icon, the readme and the licence there. Run it again to update: your settings are kept, and so is the Roadster icon already there, with any tooltypes you gave it. Roadster still runs straight from the unpacked drawer too.

Otherwise Roadster is the same as [1.1.2](https://github.com/lainejones/Roadster/releases/tag/v1.1.2).

Tested on an A4000 (AmigaOS 3.2): the installer made the drawer and copied everything there.
